query: Please implement a video number management system to manage Xiaohongshu accounts. The system should have functionalities for account management, content management, and data analysis. Users should be able to log in, manage multiple Xiaohongshu accounts, publish, edit, and delete content, view data statistics and analysis reports, and perform account settings and permission management. Style the layout with peach puff in the background and firebrick for the interface.
